$comment: DevTools overhead budgets. Deltas compare a DevTools mode with 'off' on the same app and build. Edit thresholds here; ids are used by summarize.ps1.

startup.runDeltaMs.description: winapp run (launch, no build) added time, median

startup.firstWindowDeltaMs.description: process start to first visible window added time, median

startup.settledDeltaMs.description: winapp run start to UI settled added time, median

build.runWithBuildDeltaMs.description: warm winapp run with incremental build added time, median

idle.cpuDeltaPercent.description: idle CPU added, % of one core, median over the idle window

idle.privateDelta.description: steady-state private bytes added (passes if within either the MB or the % limit), median

scroll.missedFramesDelta.description: added missed frames while scrolling a 10,000-row ListView, median

scroll.uiLagP95DeltaMs.description: added UI-thread dispatch lag p95 while scrolling, median

nav.navP50DeltaPercent.description: added time to navigate to a XAML page with ~2,200 elements, % of off

churn.createDeltaPercent.description: added time to create, show and remove elements (not rendered), % of off

churn.retainedBytesPerElement.description: memory retained per created and removed element (not rendered), median

walk.pingP95DeltaMs.description: real apps: added UI-thread ping p95 during the navigation walk, median

walk.growthDeltaMB.description: real apps: added private-bytes growth over the navigation walk, median

interaction.pickMeanMs.description: UI-thread time per pick hit test

interaction.inspectorStallMs.description: UI-thread stall while opening the inspector and selecting an element

interaction.propertyEditP95Ms.description: live property edit round trip p95

interaction.commentSaveP95Ms.description: comment save end to end (CLI) p95

stress.commentsSetMeanMs.description: UI-thread time to refresh comment pins with the stress store loaded

soak.growthDeltaMBPerHour.description: added private-bytes growth per hour of navigation and scrolling
